authoritySeparation.postalAssignment: The linked bpost workbook is a separate assignment source; its legacy XLS rows were not audited here and polygon containment does not prove current delivery assignment.
authoritySeparation.postalGeometry: The Postal cantons layer is official-derived geometry extrapolated from address points using administrative limits and roads; it is not an exact building or delivery guarantee.
authoritySeparation.administrativeCadastral: municipal, administrative, cadastral, parcel and building geometry retain their own authority and cannot replace postal-canton geometry.
authoritySeparation.buildingsAndHouseNumbers: require a separate permitted stable address/building relation and cannot be inferred from postal geometry.
